summary:
Plan of w106 (analysis-tools#r58) written.
The scenario 'install puts in the version of ruff the plugin pins' is red because its Given and Then have no step definitions, and cmd_install runs pip with the bare name ruff.
Decisions: one exact pin, as a constant in scripts/tools_env.py; a 0.17-series release to match ruff.toml (the implementer names the patch); the TOOLS row stays bare so probe and check can look up the version; the pin applies only when ruff is installed (r5); the Given reads the shipped constant and the Then asserts the call for ruff==<pin>.
Files: scripts/tools_env.py, scripts/tools (contract text), tests/scenarios/analysis_tools_probe_steps.py, ruff.toml (comment).
Tests broken: none (found by search; there is no coverage map).
